contexts.trans: 我不认为我能给出一个数字。我觉得这种分析不应该适用于人命的问题。我认为它不能以金钱形式来使用。

monetarily.def_cn: 在金钱方面，以货币形式
monetarily.def_en: in terms of money or as an amount of money

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: I don't believe I could give a number. I think that this sort of analysis shouldn't be applied to issues of human life. I think it can't be used monetarily.
contexts.trans: 我不认为我能给出一个数字。我觉得这种分析不应该适用于人命的问题。我认为它不能以金钱形式来使用。

adjust for inflation.def_cn: 根据通货膨胀进行调整
adjust for inflation.def_en: to change a money amount to reflect changes in prices over time

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: All right, let's hear someone who, you have to adjust for inflation All right, fair enough So what would the number be now? This is was thirty five years ago.
contexts.trans: 好吧，我们来听听另一个人的看法，你得根据通货膨胀进行调整。好吧，有道理。那么现在的数字应该是多少？这是三十五年前的事了。

allow for.def_en: to take something into account when making a decision or calculation

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Voicheck says we have to allow for inflation. We should be more generous.
contexts.trans: 沃伊切克说，我们必须考虑到通货膨胀。我们应该更慷慨一些。

put a number on.def_en: to assign a specific numerical value to something

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: All right, so Voicheck says- And here he disagrees with Julie. Julie says we can't put a number on human life for the purpose of a cost-benefit analysis. Voicheck says we have to because we have to make decisions somehow.
contexts.trans: 好吧，所以沃伊切克说——在这里他和朱莉意见不同。朱莉说，为了进行成本效益分析，我们不能给人命标价。沃伊切克说我们必须这么做，因为我们总得想办法做决定。

profitable.def_en: able to make money or gain a financial benefit

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: I think that if Ford and other car companies didn't use cost-benefit analysis, they'd eventually go out of business because they wouldn't be able to be profitable.
contexts.trans: 我认为，如果福特和其他汽车公司不使用成本效益分析，它们最终会倒闭，因为它们无法盈利。

sacrifice.def_en: to give up something valuable for the sake of a greater benefit

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: To feed their children, so I think that if cost-benefit analysis isn't employed, the greater good is sacrificed.
contexts.trans: 来养活他们的孩子，所以我认为，如果不采用成本效益分析，更大的善就被牺牲了。

put some value on.def_en: to assign a certain worth or importance to something

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: And yet the cost-benefit analysis, which was done by the Center for Risk Analysis at Harvard, found that if you look at the benefits Of the cell phone use and you put some value on the life, it comes out about the same.
contexts.trans: 然而，哈佛风险分析中心所做的成本效益分析发现，如果你看看使用手机的好处，并给生命赋予一定的价值，结果大致相当。

monetary.def_en: relating to money or amounts of money

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Doesn't that suggest that it's a mistake to try to put monetary figures on questions of human life?
contexts.trans: 这是否表明，试图用金钱数字来衡量人的生命问题是个错误？

derive maximum utility.def_en: to get the greatest amount of benefit or satisfaction from something

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Well I think that if the great majority of people tried to derive maximum utility out of a service like using cell phones and the convenience that cell phones provide- That sacrifice is necessary for satisfaction to occur. You're an outright utilitarian. In, yes, okay.
contexts.trans: 嗯，我认为，如果绝大多数人试图从使用手机这类服务以及手机带来的便利中获得最大效用——这种牺牲是获得满足所必需的。你就是个彻底的功利主义者。嗯，是的，好吧。

outright.def_en: complete and without any doubt or limitation

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Well I think that if the great majority of people tried to derive maximum utility out of a service like using cell phones and the convenience that cell phones provide- That sacrifice is necessary for satisfaction to occur. You're an outright utilitarian. In, yes, okay.
contexts.trans: 嗯，我认为，如果绝大多数人试图从使用手机这类服务以及手机带来的便利中获得最大效用——这种牺牲是获得满足所必需的。你就是个彻底的功利主义者。嗯，是的，好吧。

arbitrarily.def_en: in a way based on personal choice rather than rules or reason

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Well I don't want to arbitrarily calculate a figure, I mean right now- I think that you want to take it under advisement.
contexts.trans: 嗯，我不想武断地算出一个数字，我是说现在——我觉得这事你应该先考虑考虑。

take under advisement.def_en: to delay a decision on something while considering it further

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Yeah, I'll take it under advisement.
contexts.trans: 是的，我会留待考虑。

hunch.def_en: a feeling or guess about something based on instinct rather than proof

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: So what would your hunch be? How much?
contexts.trans: 那么你的直觉是什么？多少钱？

controversy.def_en: public disagreement or argument about something many people have different opinions on

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: So these are some of the controversies that arise these days from cost-benefit analysis, especially those that involve placing a dollar value on everything to be added up.
contexts.trans: 所以这些就是如今由成本效益分析引发的部分争议，尤其是那些涉及给一切事物标上美元价值再相加的做法。

place a dollar value on.def_cn: 给……标上美元价值，给……定价
place a dollar value on.def_en: to assign a specific monetary worth to something for comparison or calculation

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: So these are some of the controversies that arise these days from cost-benefit analysis, especially those that involve placing a dollar value on everything to be added up.
contexts.trans: 所以这些就是如今由成本效益分析引发的部分争议，尤其是那些涉及给一切事物标上美元价值再相加的做法。

objection.def_en: a reason someone gives for disagreeing with an idea or plan

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Well now I want to turn to your objections, to your objections not necessarily to cost-benefit analysis specifically, Because that's just one version of the utilitarian logic in practice today, but to the theory as a whole, to the idea.
contexts.trans: 那么现在我想转向你们的反对意见——未必是专门针对成本效益分析的反对意见，因为它只是当今实践中功利主义逻辑的一种版本——而是针对整个理论、针对这个观念的反对意见。

the common good.def_en: the shared benefit and well-being of all members of a community

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: How many disagree with the utilitarian approach to law and to the common good?
contexts.trans: 有多少人不同意这种对待法律和公共善的功利主义思路？

minority.def_en: the smaller number or part, especially a number that is less than half the total

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: My main issue with it is that I feel like you can't say that just because someone's in the minority what they want and need is less valuable than someone who's in the majority.
contexts.trans: 我主要的异议在于，我觉得你不能仅仅因为某人属于少数派，就说他想要和需要的东西不如多数派中某人的有价值。

have a say.def_en: to have the right or chance to influence a decision

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: There is still, what about people who are in the lesser number, like it's not fair to them, they didn't have a say in where they wanted to be.
contexts.trans: 但仍然有个问题，那些属于少数的人怎么办？这对他们不公平，他们对自己想去哪里根本没有发言权。

outweigh.def_en: to be greater in importance or influence than something else

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: She said that the minorities value less, I don't think that's the case because individually the minorities value is just the same as the individual in the majority it's just that the numbers outweigh the minority.
contexts.trans: 她说少数派的价值更低，我不这么认为，因为就个体而言，少数派中个体的价值和多数派中个体的价值是一样的，只不过人数压过了少数派。

preference.def_en: a greater liking for one thing over another

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: What do you say to Youngda? Youngda says you just have to add up people's preferences and those in the minority do have their preferences weighed.
contexts.trans: 你怎么回应Youngda？Youngda说，你只需要把人们的偏好加起来，少数人的偏好也被计入考量了。

weigh.def_en: to be considered or included in a decision or judgment

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: What do you say to Youngda? Youngda says you just have to add up people's preferences and those in the minority do have their preferences weighed.
contexts.trans: 你怎么回应Youngda？Youngda说，你只需要把人们的偏好加起来，少数人的偏好也被计入考量了。

violate.def_en: to fail to comply with a rule, principle, or right

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Can you give an example of the kind of thing you're worried about when you say you're worried about utilitarianism violating the concern or respect due the minority? Can you give an example.
contexts.trans: 你说你担心功利主义侵犯了少数人应得的关切或尊重，你能举个例子说明你担心的这类事情吗？能举个例子吗？

trade off.def_en: to give up something valuable in order to gain something else

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: So there may be a certain rights that the minority members have that the individual has that shouldn't be traded off for the sake of utility?
contexts.trans: 所以，少数群体成员拥有的某些权利，以及个人拥有的某些权利，是不是不应该为了效用而被牺牲掉？

excruciating.def_cn: 极度痛苦的，难以忍受的
excruciating.def_en: extremely painful in a way that is very hard to bear

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: If you think how the utilitarian calculus would go yes, the Christian thrown to the lion suffers enormous excruciating pain, but look at the collective ecstasy of the Romans.
contexts.trans: 如果你想想功利主义的计算会怎么算——是的，被扔给狮子的基督徒承受着巨大的、难以忍受的痛苦，但看看罗马人集体的狂喜。

collective.def_en: shared by or belonging to all members of a group

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: If you think how the utilitarian calculus would go yes, the Christian thrown to the lion suffers enormous excruciating pain, but look at the collective ecstasy of the Romans.
contexts.trans: 如果你想想功利主义的计算会怎么算——是的，被扔给狮子的基督徒承受着巨大的、难以忍受的痛苦，但看看罗马人集体的狂喜。

delirious.def_en: extremely happy and excited in an uncontrolled way

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: No but you have to admit that if there were enough Romans delirious with happiness, it would outweigh even the most excruciating pain of a handful of Christians thrown to the lion.
contexts.trans: 不，但你必须承认，如果有足够多的罗马人极度兴奋、狂喜不已，那甚至会超过被扔给狮子的少数几个基督徒最难以忍受的痛苦。

adequately.def_en: in a way that is good enough or satisfactory

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: So we really have here two different objections to utilitarianism one has to do with whether utilitarianism adequately respects individual rights or minority rights.
contexts.trans: 所以我们这里实际上有两种对功利主义的不同反对意见，一种关乎功利主义是否充分地尊重个人权利或少数人权利。

aggregate.def_en: to combine separate amounts or preferences into a single total

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: And the other has to do with the whole idea of aggregating utility for preferences or values.
contexts.trans: 另一个则涉及对偏好或价值进行效用加总这一整套理念。

uniform.def_en: not varying in form or character across different cases

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: What utilitarianism assumes, that it is possible to translate all goods, all values, all human concerns into a single uniform measure.
contexts.trans: 功利主义所假设的是，有可能把所有物品、所有价值、所有人类关切都换算成一种单一统一的尺度。

conduct a survey.def_en: to collect information by asking a group of people a set of questions

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: And he did this by conducting a survey of the young recipients of relief; this was in the 1930s.
contexts.trans: 他通过一项针对年轻救济金领取者的调查来做到这一点；那是在20世纪30年代。

keep track.def_en: to record or follow information over time

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: And he asked them, he gave them a list of unpleasant experiences and he asked them how much would you have to be paid to undergo the following experiences and he kept track.
contexts.trans: 他问他们——他给他们列了一串不愉快的经历，问他们得给多少钱才愿意经历下面这些事，然后把答案一一记录下来。

stray.def_en: having no home and living on the streets

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Or to choke a stray cat to death with your bare hands.
contexts.trans: 或者用双手把一只流浪猫掐死。

contexts.trans: 你们觉得呢，你们觉得第二贵的是什么？

least expensive.def_en: costing the smallest amount of money

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: What do you think was the least expensive item?
contexts.trans: 你们觉得最便宜的是哪一项？

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: During the depression, people were willing to have their tooth pulled for only forty five hundred dollars.
contexts.trans: 大萧条时期，只要给四千五百美元，人们就愿意让人拔掉自己的牙。

contexts.sentence: Does it support Bentham's idea that all goods, all values can be captured according to a single uniform measure of value?

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐
contexts.sentence: Maybe the things we value and cherish can't be captured according to a single uniform measure of value.
contexts.trans: 也许我们所看重、所珍视的东西，根本无法用单一统一的尺度来衡量。

contexts.sentence: I still cherish the necklace you gave me ten years ago.

contexts.sentence: And if they can't, what are the consequences for the utilitarian theory of morality? That's a question we'll continue with next time.

contexts.source_title: 第 02 集：给生命标价 / 如何衡量快乐

contexts.trans: 报应正义观主张：犯罪者必须受到与其恶行相匹配的相应报应与法律惩罚。

inviolable rights.def_cn: 【法哲学】不可侵犯的权利（人因其作为人的存在而神圣不可剥夺的基本权利）
inviolable rights.def_en: basic rights that must never be taken away or overruled by any group decision

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Do human beings have certain inviolable rights that no social calculus of utility can ever override?
contexts.trans: 人权理论主张：每个人都享有神圣不可侵犯的基本权利，绝不能沦为他人的牺牲品。

sovereign masters.def_cn: 【边沁功利论】主宰人类的两大君主（痛苦与快乐：pain and pleasure）
sovereign masters.def_en: the two supreme forces of feeling that govern all human conduct

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Bentham asserted that nature has placed mankind under the governance of two sovereign masters: pain and pleasure.
contexts.trans: 边沁写道：大自然将人类置于两个至高无上主宰的统治之下——这就是痛苦与快乐。

teleological.def_cn: 【亚里士多德哲学】目的论的（依据事物的内在目的与本质功能 Telos 进行道德定义）
teleological.def_en: explaining something by the purpose or goal it is meant to serve

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Unlike consequentialism, teleological moral philosophy asks what telos or ultimate purpose the practice serves.
contexts.trans: 目的论道德理论依据事物所追求的崇高目的与终极目标来界定正义与德性。

turn onto.def_cn: 转弯驶入，变道驶向（支轨/新方向）
turn onto.def_en: to steer a vehicle onto a side track or different route

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: You can turn the trolley car if you want to onto this side track, killing the one but sparing the five.
contexts.trans: 作为电车司机，你拥有将列车转向侧面备用轨道的物理机会，但那里站着一名工人。

push off.def_en: to shove someone so that they fall from an elevated position

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Now suppose you are standing on a bridge, and you could push this very fat man off the bridge to stop the trolley.
contexts.trans: 在第二种情境中，你必须亲手将那个大块头从天桥上推下去才能阻止电车滑行。

rely on.def_en: to depend on something as a basis for action or belief

lead to.def_cn: 导致，引向（某种困境或消极状态）
lead to.def_en: to cause something to happen or result in a situation

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Skeptical philosophy often leads to moral paralysis, where people simply give up searching for justice.
contexts.trans: 无节制地坚持绝对主义可能导致道德僵化，而无原则的功利权衡又可能导致暴政。

cast away.def_cn: 被流放漂泊，沦为海难幸存者
cast away.def_en: to abandon someone on a desolate shore or in a drifting boat

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: The four crew members were cast away on an open lifeboat sixteen hundred miles from the Cape of Good Hope.
contexts.trans: 四名遭遇海难的水手被孤零零地抛弃在南大西洋茫茫汪洋之中的一条狭小救生艇上。

resort to.def_cn: 诉诸于，采取（极端或非常规手段）
resort to.def_en: to do something extreme or unpleasant because no other option is available

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Did the captain and the mate resort to cannibalism out of sheer biological necessity, or was it cold-blooded murder?
contexts.trans: 在淡水和粮食全部耗尽之后，他们最终诉诸了极端而残忍的极端同类相食手段。

fall upon.def_cn: 落在...头上，降临于（抽签厄运）
fall upon.def_en: to be assigned to someone by chance, especially as an unlucky fate

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Dudley proposed that they should cast lots, so that the sacrifice should fall upon one person to save the rest.
contexts.trans: 如果不采取任何抽签措施，不幸的厄运最终必然会降临到最虚弱的孤儿男仆头上。

stand trial.def_cn: 出庭受审，接受司法审判
stand trial.def_en: to be brought before a court to answer a criminal charge

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Upon being rescued and brought back to England, Dudley and Stephens were arrested and made to stand trial for murder.
contexts.trans: 幸存的水手在回到英国法尔茅斯港口后随即被捕，并作为故意谋杀犯站在法庭受审。

consent to.def_cn: 同意，允许（受害者程序性同意）
consent to.def_en: to agree to something or allow it to happen

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Does the lack of consent to a lottery make the killing categorically wrong, even if it produced the greater good?
contexts.trans: 问题的核心在于：理查德·帕克生前是否曾真正自愿同意参与这场牺牲生命的抽签。

redistribute.def_en: to move money or resources from one group to another

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: And if you were a utilitarian, what would you do? What tax policy would you have? You'd redistribute in a flash, wouldn't you?
contexts.trans: 如果你是功利主义者，你会怎么做？你会有什么样的税收政策？你会立刻进行再分配，对吧？

fundamental.def_en: basic and most important, forming the foundation of something

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: It's called libertarianism because it says the fundamental individual right is the right to liberty.
contexts.trans: 它之所以叫自由至上主义，是因为它主张根本的个体权利就是自由权。

consent.def_en: the act of agreeing freely to something or giving permission

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: The second principle is: did the distribution arise from the operation of free consent, people buying and trading on the market?
contexts.trans: 第二条原则是：这种分配是否源于自由同意的运作，即人们在市场上买卖和交易？

property.def_en: things owned by someone, such as land, buildings, or possessions

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Now Nozick and other libertarians allow that there can be a minimal state that taxes people for the sake of what everybody needs, the national defense, police force, judicial system, to enforce contracts and property rights, but that's it.
contexts.trans: 那么诺齐克和其他自由至上主义者允许存在一个最弱意义上的国家，为了人人所需的东西——国防、警察、司法系统、执行契约和财产所有权——而向人们征税，但仅此而已。

taxation.def_en: the system of requiring people to pay money to the government

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: And the third kind of law or policy it is ruled out on the libertarian philosophy is any taxation Or other policy that serves the purpose of redistributing income or wealth from the rich to the poor.
contexts.trans: 而自由至上主义哲学所排除的第三种法律或政策，就是任何以把收入和财富从富人再分配给穷人为目的的征税或其他政策。

voluntary.def_en: done by choice and without being forced

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Free market enthusiasts maintain that all exchanges of goods and services must be entirely voluntary.
contexts.trans: 自由市场的拥护者坚持认为，所有商品和服务的交换都必须是完全自愿的。

entitled.def_cn: 有资格的，有权利享有...的
entitled.def_en: having a right to something because it is deserved or owed

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: If your original wealth was justly acquired, you are fully entitled to all the holdings you possess.
contexts.trans: 如果你的原始财富是正当获得的，你就完全有权利享有你所拥有的一切财产。

regulate.def_en: to control an activity by making rules for how it must be done

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Should the state have the power to regulate minimum wages and maximum working hours?
contexts.trans: 国家是否有权管制最低工资和最高工时？

welfare.def_en: the health, happiness, and well-being of a person or group

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Think back to Bentham. Bentham says we have to consider the welfare, the utility, the happiness of everybody. We have to add it all up.
contexts.trans: 回想一下边沁。边沁说我们必须考虑每个人的福祉、效用、幸福。我们必须把它们全部加起来。

ownership.def_en: the state of legally possessing something as one's own property

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: If you reject self-ownership, you must admit that society owns part of you as a collective resource.
contexts.trans: 如果你拒绝自我所有权，你就必须承认社会把你的一部分当作集体资源来拥有。

appropriation.def_en: the act of taking something for one's own use, often without permission

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Locke placed strict moral limits on the initial appropriation of unowned natural resources.
contexts.trans: 洛克对无主自然资源的初始占有施加了严格的道德限制。

entitlement.def_en: the state of having a right to something, often based on what one deserves

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Nozick's entitlement theory of justice asks not whether the distribution is equal, but whether it is historic.
contexts.trans: 诺齐克的资格正义理论所追问的，不是分配是否平等，而是分配是否具有历史性。

inviolability.def_cn: 神圣不可侵犯性，不可践踏
inviolability.def_en: the state of being impossible to violate or take away

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Libertarians declare the inviolability of private contracts forged freely by consenting parties.
contexts.trans: 自由至上主义者宣称，由各方自愿达成的私人契约具有神圣不可侵犯性。

compulsory.def_en: required by law or a rule and must be done

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Compulsory military service or conscription is viewed by pure libertarians as a form of state-enforced servitude.
contexts.trans: 强制兵役或征兵，在纯粹自由至上主义者看来，是一种国家强加的奴役。

expropriate.def_en: to take private property from someone, especially by a government, without their consent

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: The government cannot expropriate private income simply to fund popular civic projects.
contexts.trans: 政府不能仅仅为了资助受欢迎的公共项目就征用私人收入。

coercive.def_en: using force or threats to make someone do something they do not want to do

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Is taxation fundamentally different from coercive labor enforced by an authoritarian ruler?
contexts.trans: 征税与专制统治者强制的胁迫劳动，是否有根本区别？

sovereignty.def_en: the right and power to govern oneself without outside control

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Individual sovereignty over one's body means that consenting adults should have the right to sell their kidneys.
contexts.trans: 个人对自身身体的主权意味着，经本人同意的成年人应当有权出售自己的肾脏。

redistributive.def_en: taking money from some people through taxes and giving it to others

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Redistributive taxation violates freedom because it treats some people's time and effort as resources for others.
contexts.trans: 再分配性质的征税侵犯了自由，因为它把一些人的时间和努力当作供他人使用的资源。

minimal state.def_cn: 【政治哲学】守夜人国家，极小国家（功能严格限于防暴、防盗、执行契约的政府模式）
minimal state.def_en: a government whose only roles are protecting people from force and enforcing contracts

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Nozick concludes that only a minimal state, limited to enforcing contracts and protecting against force, is morally justifiable.
contexts.trans: 诺齐克得出结论：只有一种极小国家——其功能仅限于执行契约和防止暴力——在道德上才是正当的。

lockean proviso.def_cn: 【政治哲学】洛克前提条款（私有化自然资源时必须为他人留下‘足够多且同样好’的资源）
lockean proviso.def_en: the condition that taking common resources is fair only if enough and as good is left for others

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: The Lockean proviso insists that one may appropriate property only where there is enough, and as good, left in common for others.
contexts.trans: 洛克式但书坚持，一个人只有在为他人留下足够多且同样好的共有资源时，才可以占有财产。

nozickean entitlement theory.def_cn: 【正义哲学】诺齐克资格理论（正义三原则：获取正义、转让正义、矫正正义）
nozickean entitlement theory.def_en: the view that a distribution is just if it arises from fair acquisition, fair transfer, and correction of past wrongs

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Nozick's entitlement theory comprises three principles: justice in acquisition, justice in transfer, and rectification of past injustices.
contexts.trans: 诺齐克的资格理论包含三条原则：获取的正义、转让的正义，以及对过去不正义的矫正。

distributive justice.def_cn: 【政治正义论】分配正义（社会如何公平公正地分配财富、权利与社会荣誉）
distributive justice.def_en: the fair allocation of resources, wealth, and opportunities among members of a society

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Is distributive justice a matter of conforming to an ideal pattern, or respecting historical voluntary contracts?
contexts.trans: 分配正义究竟是符合某种理想模式的问题，还是尊重历史上自愿契约的问题？

taxation as forced labor.def_cn: 【哲学论证】税收等同强迫劳动论证（剥夺劳动所得即剥夺劳动时间，即强迫劳动）
taxation as forced labor.def_en: the treatment of taxes as a form of compulsory labor

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Nozick constructs a deductive chain: taking my earnings is taking my hours; taking my hours is forcing me to labor for you.
contexts.trans: 诺齐克构建了一条演绎链条：拿走我的收入，就是拿走我的时间；拿走我的时间，就是强迫我为你劳动。

natural rights.def_cn: 【古典法哲学】天赋自然权利（先于国家与法律存在的生命、自由与财产权）
natural rights.def_en: rights to life, freedom, and property that exist before any government or law

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Locke posited that in the state of nature, human beings already enjoy God-given natural rights to life, liberty, and property.
contexts.trans: 洛克假定，在自然状态下，人已经享有上帝赋予的生命、自由与财产等自然权利。

moral self-ownership.def_cn: 【本体伦理学】道德自我所有权（个人对自己肉体与灵魂拥有完整的道德主权地位）
moral self-ownership.def_en: the idea that each person has full moral authority over their own body and life

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: If I do not have moral self-ownership, then I am ultimately a possession of the sovereign state.
contexts.trans: 如果我不拥有道德自我所有权，那么我最终就是主权国家的一件财产。

free market libertarianism.def_cn: 【经济哲学】自由市场至上论（认为不受政府干涉的自由交易是保障个人自由的最佳机制）
free market libertarianism.def_en: the belief that free markets with minimal government interference best protect individual freedom

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Milton Friedman advocated free market libertarianism, arguing that occupational licensing restricts voluntary choice.
contexts.trans: 米尔顿·弗里德曼主张自由市场自由至上主义，认为职业执照制度限制了人们的自愿选择。

paternalist legislation.def_cn: 【法理批判】家长主义立法（把公民当小孩管束、干预个人自主冒险的立法行为）
paternalist legislation.def_en: a law that restricts personal choices to protect people from harming themselves

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Libertarians criticize paternalist legislation as an illegitimate infringement upon individual moral autonomy.
contexts.trans: 自由至上主义者批评家长主义立法，认为它是对个人道德自主权的不正当侵犯。

patterned principles of justice.def_cn: 【诺齐克哲学批判】模式化正义原则（试图让财富分配符合某种预先设计的模式，如平等或按劳分配）
patterned principles of justice.def_en: a rule for distributing goods according to a fixed formula such as equality or merit

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Nozick demonstrates that liberty upsets patterns: any patterned principle of justice requires continuous interference with people's lives.
contexts.trans: 诺齐克表明，自由会打乱模式：任何模式化的正义原则都要求持续不断地干涉人们的生活。

infringe upon.def_cn: 侵犯，侵夺（个人根本自由与权利）
infringe upon.def_en: to limit or violate someone's rights or freedom without permission

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Libertarians argue that redistributive taxation infringes upon the fundamental right to liberty.
contexts.trans: 自由至上主义者认为，再分配性质的税收侵犯了基本的自由权利。

stem from.def_cn: 源自于，发端于（自我所有权）
stem from.def_en: to come from or be caused by a particular source

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: All our legitimate economic rights stem from the foundational principle of self-ownership.
contexts.trans: 我们所有正当的经济权利都源自自我所有权这一根本原则。

part with.def_cn: 放弃，舍弃（个人资产与所得）
part with.def_en: to give up or let go of something valuable that one owns

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Why should the state force Michael Jordan to part with millions of dollars earned from his basketball talent?
contexts.trans: 国家凭什么强迫迈克尔·乔丹放弃他凭借篮球天赋赚来的数百万美元？

coerce into.def_en: to force someone to do something by using threats or power

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Taxing earnings from labor is like coercing an individual into unpaid forced labor for the state.
contexts.trans: 对劳动所得征税，就像强迫个人为国家从事无偿劳役。

fall back on.def_cn: 退而求助于，依靠（绝对原则）
fall back on.def_en: to rely on something as a last resort when other options fail

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: When challenged on gross inequality, libertarians always fall back on the unyielding principle of self-possession.
contexts.trans: 当在严重不平等问题上受到质疑时，自由至上主义者总是退而求助于自我占有这一不可动摇的原则。

amount to.def_en: to be the same as something in effect or meaning

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: If the government claims a 30 percent portion of my income, does that not amount to owning 30 percent of my time and person?
contexts.trans: 如果政府拿走我收入的30%，那不就等同于拥有我30%的时间和人身吗？

lay claim to.def_cn: 声称对...拥有所有权/权利
lay claim to.def_en: to assert a right to own or control something

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Can society legitimately lay claim to a healthy person's spare kidney to save someone dying of renal failure?
contexts.trans: 社会能不能正当地要求一个健康人捐出他多余的肾脏，来救一个肾衰竭濒死的人？

give up.def_en: to surrender or relinquish something, such as control or a right

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Those who disagree argue that when you live in an organized society, you give up absolute control over your earnings.
contexts.trans: 持反对意见的人则认为，当你生活在一个有组织的社会中时，你就放弃了对自身收入的绝对控制权。

harmony.def_en: a state of peaceful agreement among different parts

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Plato argues that justice in the soul is a condition of internal psychic harmony.
contexts.trans: 柏拉图认为，灵魂中的正义是一种内在心灵和谐的状态。

rational.def_en: based on clear thought and logic rather than emotion

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: The rational part of our mind seeks truth, wisdom, and genuine understanding.
contexts.trans: 我们心灵中的理性部分追求真理、智慧与真正的理解。

conflict.def_en: a serious disagreement or struggle between opposing forces or desires

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: When our rational reflection clashes with bodily desires, we experience acute internal conflict.
contexts.trans: 当我们的理性反思与身体欲望发生冲突时，我们就会体验到剧烈的内心冲突。

virtue.def_en: a good quality in a person's character shown by doing what is right

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: For Aristotle, moral virtue is acquired through regular habituation and deliberate practice.
contexts.trans: 在亚里士多德看来，道德德性是通过经常性的习惯养成和刻意的练习获得的。

reflection.def_en: the act of thinking carefully and deeply about one's own beliefs and actions

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Philosophical reflection allows us to critically evaluate impulses before acting upon them.
contexts.trans: 哲学反思让我们能够在付诸行动之前，批判性地审视自己的冲动。

proportion.def_en: a balanced relationship among the parts of something, each having its proper size or amount

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: A well-ordered soul keeps each of its three constituent parts in proper proportion.
contexts.trans: 一个秩序良好的灵魂使其三个组成部分保持恰当的比例。

flourish.def_cn: 繁荣，昌盛；蓬勃发展（潜能完全实现）
flourish.def_en: to grow and develop fully in a healthy and successful way

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Human beings cannot truly flourish if their rational faculties are enslaved by base appetites.
contexts.trans: 如果人的理性能力被低级的欲望所奴役，人类就无法真正繁盛生活。

discipline.def_en: the ability to control your own behavior and make yourself work or act in a controlled way

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Cultivating temperance requires mental discipline and steady cognitive regulation.
contexts.trans: 培养节制需要精神上的自律和稳定的认知调节。

perspective.def_en: a particular way of thinking about or understanding something

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Ancient philosophy offers a profound perspective on modern cognitive science.
contexts.trans: 古代哲学为现代认知科学提供了一个深刻的视角。

eudaimonia.def_cn: 【希腊哲学】至善幸福，人生繁盛（潜能完全实现的高贵生命状态）
eudaimonia.def_en: the state of living a full and good life by realizing one's true potential through virtuous action

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Aristotle defines eudaimonia as an activity of the soul in accordance with complete virtue.
contexts.trans: 亚里士多德将至善幸福定义为灵魂依照完满德性而进行的活动。

temperance.def_cn: 节制，克制，自律（古希腊四主德之一）
temperance.def_en: the quality of controlling one's desires and acting with self-restraint

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: In Plato's Republic, temperance is the harmonious agreement between reason, spirit, and appetite.
contexts.trans: 在柏拉图的《理想国》中，节制是理性、激情与欲望之间的和谐一致。

cognitive.def_cn: 认知的，感知的，思维结构的
cognitive.def_en: relating to thinking, understanding, and mental processes

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Modern cognitive science confirms that moral judgment relies on both intuitive heuristic processes and deliberate reflection.
contexts.trans: 现代认知科学证实，道德判断既依赖直觉式的启发式过程，也依赖深思熟虑的反思。

tripartite.def_cn: 由三部分组成的，三分的
tripartite.def_en: having three distinct parts or divisions

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Plato proposes a famous tripartite division of the human soul: reason, spirit, and appetite.
contexts.trans: 柏拉图提出了著名的人类灵魂三分法：理性、激情与欲望。

charioteer.def_en: a person who drives a horse-drawn vehicle used in ancient races and battles

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: In the Phaedrus, Socrates likens the soul to a charioteer driving two winged steeds with conflicting natures.
contexts.trans: 在《斐德罗篇》中，苏格拉底将灵魂比作一位驾驭着两匹天性冲突的带翼骏马的御者。

akrasia.def_cn: 【哲学】无自制力，软弱，明知故犯（知道正确的事却屈服于欲望）
akrasia.def_en: the state of acting against what one knows is best

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: The ancient philosophical problem of akrasia investigates why we act against our own better moral judgment.
contexts.trans: 古代哲学中的无自制力问题，探究的是我们为什么会违背自己更好的道德判断而行动。

contemplation.def_en: the activity of thinking deeply and quietly about important things

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Aristotle concluded that the highest form of eudaimonia is found in philosophical contemplation.
contexts.trans: 亚里士多德得出结论：幸福的最高形式存在于哲学沉思之中。

hedonism.def_cn: 享乐主义（将追逐当下生理快感视为人生唯一目标）
hedonism.def_en: the belief that pleasure is the only good in life

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Socrates contrasts genuine virtue with crude hedonism that seeks only immediate sensory gratification.
contexts.trans: 苏格拉底将真正的美德与只追求当下感官满足的粗陋享乐主义相对照。

stoicism.def_cn: 斯多葛哲学，坚忍主义，不为外物所动
stoicism.def_en: the belief that we should stay calm and accept what we cannot control

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Stoicism teaches that peace of mind comes from distinguishing what is within our control from what is not.
contexts.trans: 斯多葛哲学教导我们，内心的平静来自分清哪些事在我们掌控之中、哪些不在。

equilibrium.def_en: a state of balance in which different forces or feelings are equal

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: A healthy mind achieves dynamic equilibrium when reason guides our emotional passions without violently repressing them.
contexts.trans: 当理性引导我们的情感激情而不强行压制它们时，健康的心灵便达到动态平衡。

cardinal.def_en: most important or fundamental among a set of things

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Wisdom, courage, temperance, and justice constitute the four cardinal virtues of classical Greek thought.
contexts.trans: 智慧、勇敢、节制和正义构成了古典希腊思想中的四大主要德性。

tripartite theory of soul.def_cn: 【柏拉图心理哲学】灵魂三分说（理性 Logistikon、激情 Thumos、欲望 Epithumetikon）
tripartite theory of soul.def_en: the idea that the soul has three separate parts: reason, spirit, and desire

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Plato's tripartite theory of the soul maps onto his ideal republic: philosopher kings, guardians, and producers.
contexts.trans: 柏拉图的灵魂三分说对应着他理想城邦中的三个阶层：哲学王、护卫者与生产者。

allegory of the chariot.def_cn: 【柏拉图经典寓言】双马战车寓言（黑马代表桀骜欲望，白马代表崇高激情，御者代表理性）
allegory of the chariot.def_en: a picture-story in which a driver controls two horses, one good and one wild, to show how reason guides the soul

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: In the allegory of the chariot, the charioteer must steer a noble white steed and a recalcitrant dark steed toward the heavens.
contexts.trans: 在战车寓言中，御者必须驾驭一匹高贵的白马和一匹桀骜不驯的黑马，朝着天国前行。

platonic justice.def_cn: 【柏拉图正义观】内在正义（心灵各部分恪尽职守、互不越俎代庖的良序状态）
platonic justice.def_en: the state of a soul where each part does its own job without interfering with others

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Platonic justice is defined as each part of the soul minding its own proper business without meddling in the others.
contexts.trans: 柏拉图式的正义被界定为：灵魂的每一部分各司其职，互不越俎代庖。

aristotelian virtue ethics.def_cn: 【规范伦理学】亚里士多德德性伦理学（强调品德修养与实践智慧 Phronesis，而非死板准则）
aristotelian virtue ethics.def_en: an ethical theory emphasizing good character and practical wisdom over rigid moral rules

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Aristotelian virtue ethics focuses on the character of the moral agent rather than adherence to strict utilitarian rules.
contexts.trans: 亚里士多德德性伦理学关注的是道德行为者的品格，而非对严格功利主义规则的遵守。

doctrine of the mean.def_cn: 【中庸之道】黄金中道原则（美德是介于不及与过度两个极端之间的适度适中）
doctrine of the mean.def_en: the idea that virtue lies at the balanced middle point between two opposite extremes

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Aristotle's doctrine of the mean defines virtue as a golden mean between two opposing vices of excess and deficiency.
contexts.trans: 亚里士多德的中庸之道把德性定义为介于过度与不及这两种对立恶习之间的黄金中道。

eudaimonic flourishing.def_cn: 【希腊至善论】德性繁盛生活（人性潜能得到完全充分实现的生活终极目标）
eudaimonic flourishing.def_en: a life of true human flourishing achieved by fully developing one's potential through moral virtue and noble deeds

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Eudaimonic flourishing differs fundamentally from transient hedonic pleasure by requiring moral integrity and noble activity.
contexts.trans: 德性幸福与短暂的享乐快感有着根本区别，因为它要求道德操守和高尚的行为。

dual-process cognition.def_cn: 【现代认知心理学】双进程认知理论（系统1直觉自动化 vs 系统2深思熟虑理性反思）
dual-process cognition.def_en: the theory that the mind uses two separate systems, one fast and intuitive, the other slow and deliberate

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Dual-process cognitive models in behavioral psychology closely mirror Plato's ancient intuition about conflicting mental faculties.
contexts.trans: 行为心理学中的双进程认知模型，与柏拉图关于心灵能力相互冲突的古老直觉高度吻合。

cognitive reappraisal.def_cn: 【情绪调节心理学】认知重评（通过改变对处境的解读来理性调控情绪反应）
cognitive reappraisal.def_en: the mental process of changing how you interpret a situation to control your emotional response

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Cognitive reappraisal allows the rational intellect to modulate intense emotional reactions before they lead to irrational actions.
contexts.trans: 认知重评让理性智识能够在强烈情绪反应导致不理性行为之前对其加以调节。

moral intuitionism.def_cn: 【元伦理学】道德直觉主义（主张道德真理具有自明性并能为理性直觉直接把握）
moral intuitionism.def_en: the view that basic moral truths are known directly by intuition

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: Moral intuitionism holds that foundational moral truths are immediately evident to our intellectual perception without formal proof.
contexts.trans: 道德直觉主义认为，根本性的道德真理无需形式证明，就能被我们的理智直觉直接把握。

cardinal virtues.def_cn: 【古希腊伦理基石】四主德（智慧 Phronesis、勇敢 Andreia、节制 Sophrosyne、正义 Dikaiosyne）
cardinal virtues.def_en: the four most important qualities of good character in ancient Greek ethics

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：秩序井然的心灵 / 幸福与内在和谐
contexts.sentence: The cardinal virtues represent the four essential pillars supporting both an honorable life and a harmonious commonwealth.
contexts.trans: 四主德代表着支撑体面生活与和谐共同体的四大支柱。

libertarian.def_cn: 自由至上主义者；自由至上主义的
libertarian.def_en: a person who believes that individual freedom should be protected from government interference

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: That's all to do with the question of collective goods and the libertarian's injunction against paternalism.
contexts.trans: 这全都涉及集体物品的问题，以及自由至上主义者反对家长式作风的告诫。

paternalist.def_cn: 家长式统治的；家长主义者
paternalist.def_en: relating to a system where authorities decide what is best for people

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: One of them is paternalist legislation. That's passing laws that protect people from themselves.
contexts.trans: 其中之一就是家长式立法。也就是通过法律来保护人们免受自己的伤害。

proprietors.def_en: people who have legal ownership of themselves or their own person

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: If you want to take rights seriously, if you don't want to just regard people as collections of preferences, the fundamental moral idea to which you will be led is the idea that we are the owners or the proprietors of our own person.
contexts.trans: 如果你想认真对待权利，如果你不想仅仅把人看作偏好的集合，那么你将被引向的根本道德观念就是：我们是我们自身人身的所有者或拥有者。

acquisition.def_en: the act of getting or obtaining something

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: The first he calls justice in acquisition or in initial holdings.
contexts.trans: 第一条他称之为获取正义，或初始持有的正义。

violation.def_en: an action that breaks a law or someone's rights

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Libertarians say that's also a violation of the right to liberty.
contexts.trans: 自由至上主义者说，那也侵犯了自由权。

legislation.def_en: laws enacted by a government or other governing body

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: One of them is paternalist legislation. That's passing laws that protect people from themselves.
contexts.trans: 其中之一就是家长式立法。也就是通过法律来保护人们免受自己的伤害。

theft.def_en: the act of taking money or property from someone without their permission

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: What it amounts to is theft by the state or by the majority, if we're talking about a democracy, from people who happen to do very well and earn a lot of money.
contexts.trans: 这实际上就是国家或多数人——如果我们谈的是民主制的话——对碰巧干得非常好、赚了很多钱的人的一种盗窃。

extrapolated.def_en: inferred or extended from known facts or agreed principles to unknown cases

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: If you look at the argument the poor need the money more, at no point in that argument you contradict the fact that we extrapolated from agreed upon principles that people own themselves.
contexts.trans: 如果你看看“穷人更需要这笔钱”这个论点，这个论点从头到尾都没有反驳这样一个事实：我们从公认的原则中推断出，人拥有自身。

hustings.def_en: the activity of making speeches and campaigning to win people's votes

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Why can't you, we live in a democratic society with freedom of speech, why can't you take to the hustings, persuade your fellow citizens that taxation is unjust and try to get a majority?
contexts.trans: 为什么你不能——我们生活在一个有言论自由的民主社会里，为什么你不能登上竞选讲台，说服你的同胞公民税收是不公正的，并争取赢得多数支持呢？

mob.def_en: a large disorderly crowd that may become violent and out of control

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: Exactly, but in a democracy, aren't you for democracy? Yes, I'm for democracy, but hang on, democracy and mob rule are not the same thing. Mob rule? Mob rule. But in an open society, you have recourse.
contexts.trans: 没错，但在一个民主国家里，难道你不支持民主吗？是的，我支持民主，但等等，民主和暴民统治不是一回事。暴民统治？暴民统治。但在一个开放社会里，你有救济的途径。

constitution.def_en: a set of basic laws that limit and organize how a country is governed

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: No, I just believe in a very limited form of democracy whereby we have a constitution that severely limits the scope of what decisions can be made democratically.
contexts.trans: 不，我只是信奉一种非常有限的民主形式，即我们有一部宪法，严格限制哪些决定可以通过民主方式作出。

incentive.def_en: a reason or reward that makes someone want to act in a certain way

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: He replied, once we verified there was no danger to a member's property, we had no choice but to back off according to our rules. If we responded to all fires, he said, there would be no incentive to subscribe.
contexts.trans: 他回答说，一旦我们确认没有会员的财产面临危险，按照我们的规定，我们就别无选择，只能撤退。他说，如果我们对所有火灾都出警，那就没有付费订阅的动机了。

displaced.def_cn: 流离失所的；被迫离开的
displaced.def_en: forced to leave home because of a disaster

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: And that's also why it's wrong to tax the rich to help the poor, even for good causes, even to help those who are displaced by the hurricane Katrina.
contexts.trans: 这也是为什么向富人征税来帮助穷人是不对的，即便出于好的目的，即便为了帮助那些因卡特里娜飓风而流离失所的人。

hurricane.def_en: a violent tropical storm with very strong winds and heavy rain

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: And that's also why it's wrong to tax the rich to help the poor, even for good causes, even to help those who are displaced by the hurricane Katrina.
contexts.trans: 这也是为什么向富人征税来帮助穷人是不对的，即便出于好的目的，即便为了帮助那些因卡特里娜飓风而流离失所的人。

violates.def_en: to break a rule or principle that should be followed

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: But that violates the fundamental principle that we belong to ourselves.
contexts.trans: 但这违反了那条基本原则：我们属于我们自己。

justified.def_en: able to be shown as right or acceptable in a particular situation

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: He's more demanding than Joe. Joe says it is theft, maybe in an extreme case it's justified.
contexts.trans: 他比乔要求更严格。乔说这是盗窃，也许在极端情况下是正当的。

morally.def_en: in a way that relates to right and wrong behavior

contexts.source_title: 第 03 集：自由选择权 / 谁拥有我的身体与劳动？
contexts.sentence: But if the state has the right to take my earnings or the fruits of my labor, isn't that morally the same as according to the state the right to claim a portion of my labor?
contexts.trans: 但如果国家有权拿走我的收入或我的劳动成果，这在道德上不就等同于赋予国家索取我一部分劳动的权利吗？

contexts.sentence: It is the 27th of June of 2013. The Blue Dreams are plural. The Blue Dreams are many. Interlingua is not the only one. contexts.trans: 今天是 2013 年 6 月 27 日。藍色夢想不只有一種，而是有很多種。國際語並非唯一。幾十年來，一直存在著其他拉丁語系的人工語言，分別屬於不同的專案。未來，有些人寄望於其他語言。但世界語，這個綠色夢想，卻成功傳承了一個多世紀。幾十年來，推行世界語的革命嘗試都以失敗告終，因為真正的世界語擁有一種無法篡改的藝術平衡。世界語依然歷久不衰。在藍色陣營中，我仍然選擇國際語。應該有更多的人給它一個機會。世界語的重音賦予了這種語言一種魅力，或許正是這種魅力推動了它多年來的生存。但世界上也有其他替代方案。

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Whereas pushing the fat man over is an actual act of murder on your part. You have control over that.
contexts.trans: 而把那个胖子推下去，则是你这边实实在在的谋杀行为。这一点你是能控制的。

justifies.def_en: to give a good reason for something that seems wrong

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Well I think that same type of mentality that justifies genocide and totalitarianism in order to save one type of race you wipe out the other.
contexts.trans: 嗯，我觉得正是那种为种族灭绝和极权主义辩护的同一类思维方式——为了拯救一个种族，你就消灭另一个种族。

sacrificing.def_en: giving up something valuable for the sake of something else

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Here's the obvious question, what became of the principle better to save five lives even if it means sacrificing one, what became of the principal that almost everyone endorsed in the first case?
contexts.trans: 这里有个显而易见的问题：那个“宁可牺牲一个人也要救五个人”的原则怎么了？那个在第一个案例中几乎所有人都赞同的原则怎么了？

circumstance.def_en: a fact or situation that affects what happens or what you can do

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: So the principle there was the same on 9/11. It's tragic circumstance, but better to kill one so that five can live is that the reason most of you have, those of you who would turn, yes?
contexts.trans: 所以那里的原则和9/11时是一样的。这是个悲惨的情况，但杀一个人好让五个人活下来，这是你们大多数人的理由吗，你们这些会这么做的人，是吗？

whereas.def_en: used to contrast two facts or situations

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Whereas pushing the fat man over is an actual act of murder on your part. You have control over that.
contexts.trans: 而把那个胖子推下去，则是你这边实实在在的谋杀行为。这一点你是能控制的。

necessarily.def_en: in a way that is certain or cannot be avoided

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Not necessarily because of your direct actions. The trolley car is a runaway thing and you need to make in a split second choice.
contexts.trans: 这未必是因为你的直接行为。电车已经失控了，你必须在瞬间做出选择。

conscious.def_en: done on purpose after thinking about it

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Which is an act of conscious thought to turn, or you choose to push the fat man?
contexts.trans: 要么是有意识地扳动道岔，要么是你选择把那个胖子推下去？

active.def_en: involving deliberate effort or conscious choice

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: over which is also an active conscious action. So either way you're making a choice.
contexts.trans: 这也是一种主动的、有意识的行为。所以无论哪种方式，你都是在做选择。

actual.def_en: real and existing in fact, not just imagined

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Whereas pushing the fat man over is an actual act of murder on your part. You have control over that.
contexts.trans: 而把那个胖子推下去，则是你这边实实在在的谋杀行为。这一点你是能控制的。

assume.def_en: to accept something as true without proof

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Let's assume you know that for sure, and so you feel helpless.
contexts.trans: 让我们假定你确信这一点，因此你感到无助。

reasons.def_en: the facts or causes that explain why something happens or is done

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Let's hear first. Now we need to begin to investigate the reasons why you think.
contexts.trans: 我们先来听听。现在我们需要开始探究你们这样想的理由。

choice.def_en: a decision to pick one thing or person instead of another

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Well I guess in the first case where you have the one worker and the five it's a choice between those two, and you have to make a certain choice and people are going to die because of the trolley car.
contexts.trans: 嗯，我想在第一种情况里，你面对的是一个工人和五个人，这是在这两者之间做选择，你必须做出某个选择，而人们会因为那辆电车而死。

choose.def_en: to decide which one you want from two or more possibilities

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: I don't think that's a very good reason because you choose either way you have to choose who dies because you either choose to turn and kill a person.
contexts.trans: 我觉得那不是个很好的理由，因为无论哪种方式，你都得选择谁死，因为你要么选择扳道岔杀死一个人，

willing.def_en: ready or eager to do something

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Who's willing to volunteer a reason? Go ahead, stand up. Because it can't be right to kill five people when you can only kill one person instead. It wouldn't be right to kill five if you could kill one person instead.
contexts.trans: 谁愿意自告奋勇说个理由？来吧，站起来。因为明明可以只杀一个人，却要杀五个人，这肯定不对。明明可以只杀一个人，却要杀五个人，这是不对的。

majority.def_en: the larger part or number of a group

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Keep your hands up, those of you who'd go straight ahead. A handful of people would, the vast majority would turn.
contexts.trans: 会直行的人，把手举着。少数人会直行，绝大多数人会转向。

fair.def_en: reasonable and acceptable in the circumstances

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Fair enough, it still seems wrong in a way that it doesn't seem wrong in the first case to turn, you say.
contexts.trans: 有道理，但你说，它在某种意义上仍然显得不对，而在第一种情况下转动方向盘却并不显得不对。

severely.def_en: in a very bad or serious way

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Five of them sustained moderate injuries, one is severely injured. You could spend all day caring for the one severely injured victim.
contexts.trans: 其中五人受了中度伤，一人受了重伤。你可以花一整天照顾那一名重伤者。

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Five of them sustained moderate injuries, one is severely injured. You could spend all day caring for the one severely injured victim.
contexts.trans: 其中五人受了中度伤，一人受了重伤。你可以花一整天照顾那一名重伤者。

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: And six patients come to you, they've been in a terrible trolley car wreck.
contexts.trans: 有六名病人来找你，他们遭遇了一场可怕的电车事故。

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Certain moral principles have already begun to emerge from the discussions we've had.
contexts.trans: 从我们刚才的讨论中，某些道德原则已经开始浮现出来。

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: The first moral principle that emerged from the discussion said that the right thing to do, the moral thing to do, depends on the consequences that will result from your action.
contexts.trans: 讨论中浮现出的第一条道德原则是：正确的做法、道德的做法，取决于你的行为将会带来什么后果。

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Today and in the next few days we will begin to examine one of the most influential versions of consequentialist moral theory, and that's the philosophy of utilitarianism.
contexts.trans: 今天以及接下来的几天，我们将开始考察后果主义道德理论中最有影响力的版本之一，那就是功利主义哲学。

philosophical.def_en: relating to the study of the nature of knowledge, reality, and existence

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: You'll notice too from the syllabus that we don't only read these books, we also all take up contemporary political and legal controversies that raise philosophical questions.
contexts.trans: 你们从教学大纲中还会注意到，我们不只是读这些书，我们还会讨论当代政治和法律中引发哲学问题的种种争议。

political.def_en: relating to government, public affairs, or the distribution of power in society

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: You'll notice too from the syllabus that we don't only read these books, we also all take up contemporary political and legal controversies that raise philosophical questions.

arguments.def_en: reasons or sets of reasons given to support a point of view

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: We noticed two things about the arguments we had. One had to do with the way we were arguing.
contexts.trans: 我们注意到我们所做的论证有两个特点。一个与我们论证的方式有关。

arguing.def_en: presenting opposing views or reasons in a dispute

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: We didn't resolve, once and for all, either the cases or the principles we were arguing when we began.
contexts.trans: 我们并没有一劳永逸地解决我们一开始所论证的那些案例或原则。

absolute.def_en: existing independently and not relative to anything else

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Categorical moral reasoning locates morality in certain absolute moral requirements, in certain categorical duties and rights, regardless of the consequences.
contexts.trans: 定言道德推理把道德置于某些绝对的道德要求之中，置于某些定言的义务和权利之中，而不论后果如何。

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: But the very fact that they have reoccurred and persisted may suggest that, though they're impossible in one sense, they're unavoidable in another.
contexts.trans: 但这些问题反复出现、持续存在这一事实本身或许表明，虽然它们在一种意义上是不可能的，在另一种意义上却是不可避免的。

evasion.def_en: the act of avoiding or escaping something, especially a duty or question

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Those are the risks, personal and political, and in the face of these risks, there is a characteristic evasion.
contexts.trans: 这些就是风险，个人的和政治的，而面对这些风险，有一种典型的回避方式。

debate.def_en: to discuss different opinions about a subject in a formal way

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: We will debate equality and inequality, affirmative action, free speech versus hate speech, same sex marriage, military conscription.
contexts.trans: 我们将辩论平等与不平等、平权行动、言论自由与仇恨言论、同性婚姻、征兵制。

debated.def_en: people have discussed and argued about it over a long period

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: It's true these questions have been debated for a very long time.
contexts.trans: 的确，这些问题已经被争论了很长时间。

resolve.def_en: to find an answer to a problem or end a disagreement

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: We didn't resolve, once and for all, either the cases or the principles we were arguing when we began.
contexts.trans: 我们并没有一劳永逸地解决我们一开始争论的那些案例或原则。

examine.def_en: to look at or study something carefully to understand it

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: You will examine the presuppositions of public policy, you will hone your political judgment, you'll become a more effective participant in public affairs.
contexts.trans: 你将审查公共政策的种种预设，你将磨砺自己的政治判断力，你将成为一个更有效的公共事务参与者。

explore.def_en: to examine or discuss a subject carefully in order to learn more about it

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: We're going to explore in the days and weeks to come the contrast between consequentialist and categorical moral principles.
contexts.trans: 在接下来的日子里，我们将探讨后果主义道德原则与绝对主义道德原则之间的对比。

influential.def_en: having a strong effect on people or events

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: The most influential example of consequential moral reasoning is utilitarianism, a doctrine invented by Jeremy Bentham, the eighteenth century English political philosopher.
contexts.trans: 后果主义道德推理最有影响力的例子是功利主义，这是由十八世纪英国政治哲学家杰里米·边沁创立的一种学说。

reason.def_en: the power of the mind to think, understand, and form judgments logically

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Immanuel Kant described very well the problem with skepticism when he wrote Skepticism is a resting place for human reason where it can reflect upon its dogmatic wanderings, but it is no dwelling place for permanent settlement.
contexts.trans: 伊曼努尔·康德非常精辟地描述了怀疑论的问题，他写道：怀疑论是人类理性的一个休憩之所，理性可以在此反思自己独断的漫游，但它并不是可以永久定居的住所。

restlessness.def_en: a feeling of being unable to stay still or be satisfied

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Simply to acquiesce in skepticism, Kant wrote, can never suffice to overcome the restlessness of reason.
contexts.trans: 康德写道，仅仅默认怀疑主义，永远不足以克服理性的躁动不安。

judgments.def_en: opinions or conclusions formed after thinking carefully about something

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: It began with our judgments in particular cases. We tried to articulate the reasons or the principles lying behind our judgments.
contexts.trans: 它始于我们对具体案例的判断。我们试图阐明这些判断背后的理由或原则。

categorically.def_en: in a way that is absolute and allows no exceptions

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Some people argued that there are certain things that are just categorically wrong even if they bring about a good result, even if they save five people at the cost of one life.
contexts.trans: 有些人主张，有些事情就是绝对错误的，即使它们带来好的结果，即使它们以牺牲一条生命为代价拯救五个人。

prayer.def_en: a solemn request for help or expression of thanks addressed to a deity

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Dudley offered a prayer, he told the boy his time had come, and he killed him with a pen knife, stabbing him in the jugular vein.
contexts.trans: 达德利做了祈祷，他告诉男孩他的大限到了，然后用一把削笔刀杀了他，刺中了他的颈静脉。

survivors.def_en: people who continue to live after a dangerous event

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: The three survivors were picked up by a German ship. They were taken back to Falmouth in England where they were arrested and tried.
contexts.trans: 三名幸存者被一艘德国船救起。他们被带回英国的法尔茅斯，在那里被捕并受审。

justifiable.def_cn: 可证明为正当的；有理由的
justifiable.def_en: able to be shown as right or reasonable

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: I'm wondering if Dudley and Stephens had asked for Richard Parker's consent in, you know, dying, if that would, would that exonerate them from an act of murder, and if so, is that still morally justifiable?
contexts.trans: 我在想，如果达德利和斯蒂芬斯曾征求理查德·帕克对赴死的同意，你知道，那是否能让他们免于谋杀罪，如果是这样，那在道德上是否仍然可证明为正当？

defense.def_en: the reasons or arguments someone gives to show they are not guilty

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: They claimed they had acted out of necessity that was their defense. They argued in effect better that one should die so that three could survive.
contexts.trans: 他们声称自己是迫不得已才这么做的，这就是他们的辩护理由。他们实际上主张，一个人死去，好让三个人活下来，这样更好。

guilty.def_en: having done something wrong or having broken the law

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: And how many would vote guilty what they did was morally wrong?
contexts.trans: 有多少人会投有罪，认为他们的行为在道德上是错的？

trial.def_en: a legal process in which a court decides if someone is guilty

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Dudley and Stephens went to trial. They didn't dispute the facts.
contexts.trans: 达德利和斯蒂芬斯接受了审判。他们并未对事实提出异议。

crime.def_en: an illegal action that can be punished by law

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: I think the essential element, in my mind, that makes it a crime is the idea that they decided at some point that their lives were more important than his, and that.
contexts.trans: 在我看来，使其构成罪行的关键要素，就是他们认为自己的生命比他的更重要，而且他们就这么决定了。

law.def_en: the set of rules made by a government that everyone must obey

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: And just to simplify the discussion put aside the question of law, and let's assume that You as the jury are charged with deciding whether what they did was morally permissible or not.
contexts.trans: 为了简化讨论，我们先撇开法律问题不谈，假设你们作为陪审团，任务是裁定他们的行为在道德上是否可允许。

argued.def_en: presented reasons in support of a particular opinion or claim

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: They claimed they had acted out of necessity that was their defense. They argued in effect better that one should die so that three could survive.
contexts.trans: 他们声称自己是迫不得已才这么做的，这就是他们的辩护理由。他们实际上主张，一个人死去，好让三个人活下来，这样更好。

procedure.def_en: a series of actions taken in a particular order to achieve a result

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: But if there were a lottery and they all agreed to the procedure, you think that would be okay?
contexts.trans: 但如果是抽签，而且他们都同意了这个程序，你觉得那就可以了吗？

happiness.def_en: the feeling of being pleased and content with your life

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Do you think Bentham was wrong to say the right thing to do is to add up the collected happiness? You think he's wrong about that?
contexts.trans: 你认为边沁说正确的做法是把收集起来的幸福加起来，这是错的吗？你觉得他在这点上错了吗？

philosophers.def_en: people who study and write about the nature of knowledge, reality, and existence

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: To investigate those three questions, we're going to have to read some philosophers and starting next time we're going to read Bentham, and John Stuart Mill, utilitarian philosophers.
contexts.trans: 为了探究这三个问题，我们得读一些哲学家的著作，从下次课开始，我们要读边沁和约翰·斯图亚特·密尔，功利主义哲学家。

defenders.def_en: people who support someone or something against criticism

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Alright, good. So are there any other defenders who, who say it's just categorically wrong, with or without consent? Yes, stand up. Why?
contexts.trans: 好，很好。那么还有没有其他辩护者，认为无论同意与否，这都绝对是错的？好，站起来。为什么？

versus.def_en: used to compare two things or choices, especially in a conflict

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: There were three lives at stake versus one, The one, that the cabin boy, he had no family, he had no dependents. These other three had families back home in England, they had dependents, they had wives and children.
contexts.trans: 当时是三条人命对一条人命。那个船舱男孩，就他一个，没有家人，没有需要他抚养的人。而另外三个人在英格兰老家都有家庭，有需要他们抚养的人，有妻子和孩子。

whether.def_en: used to introduce a choice or doubt between alternatives

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: The way I understood it originally was that that was the whole issue, is that the cabin boy was never consulted about whether or not something was going to happen to him, even though with the original.
contexts.trans: 我最初的理解是，问题的关键就在于，从来没有人问过那个船舱男孩，是否愿意接受将发生在他身上的事，尽管按照最初的……

stake.def_en: the important things that could be gained or lost in a situation

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: a range of practical questions, why not just to enliven these abstract and distant books but to make clear, to bring out what's at stake in our everyday lives, including our political lives, for philosophy.
contexts.trans: 一系列实际问题，这么做不仅是为了让这些抽象而遥远的书鲜活起来，更是为了阐明、揭示出哲学在我们日常生活中——包括我们的政治生活中——所牵涉的利害关系。

stakes.def_en: the important things that could be won or lost in a situation

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Suppose there weren't three, suppose there were thirty, three hundred, one life to save three hundred. Or in more time, three thousand, or suppose the stakes were even bigger.
contexts.trans: 假设不是三条命，假设是三十条、三百条，用一条命去救三百条命。或者时间更长，三千条，又或者假设利害关系更大。

suffering.def_en: great pain or unhappiness that someone experiences

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: So if you add up, if you tried to calculate the balance of happiness and suffering, you might have a case for saying what they did was the right thing.
contexts.trans: 所以，如果你把快乐和痛苦加总起来，如果你试着计算快乐与痛苦的平衡，你也许就有理由说他们所做的是对的。

balance.def_en: a state in which opposing forces or influences are equal or in the correct proportions

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: So if you add up, if you tried to calculate the balance of happiness and suffering, you might have a case for saying what they did was the right thing.
contexts.trans: 所以，如果你把快乐和痛苦加总起来，如果你试着计算快乐与痛苦的平衡，你也许就有理由说他们所做的是对的。

overall.def_en: relating to or including everything as a whole

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Murder is murder, it's always wrong, even if it increases the overall happiness of society, the categorical objection.
contexts.trans: 谋杀就是谋杀，它永远是错的，即使它增加了社会的总体幸福，这就是绝对主义的反对意见。

society.def_en: the people living together in a community with shared laws and customs

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: I think undoubtedly the way our society is shaped, murder is murder.
contexts.trans: 我认为毫无疑问，从我们社会的塑造方式来看，谋杀就是谋杀。

philosopher.def_en: a person who studies ideas about knowledge and existence

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: The most influential example of consequential moral reasoning is utilitarianism, a doctrine invented by Jeremy Bentham, the eighteenth century English political philosopher.
contexts.trans: 后果论道德推理最有影响力的例子是功利主义，这是由十八世纪英国政治哲学家杰里米·边沁创立的一种学说。

risks.def_en: possible dangers or bad things that could happen

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: To read these books in this way, as an exercise in self-knowledge, to read them in this way carry certain risks.
contexts.trans: 以这种方式阅读这些书，将其作为一种自我认识的练习，这样读会带来某些风险。

philosophizing.def_en: to think deeply and critically about fundamental questions of life and knowledge

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: And you see this going back to Socrates, there's a dialogue, the Gorgias, In which one of Socrates' friends, Callicles, tries to talk him out of philosophizing.
contexts.trans: 你可以看到，这可以追溯到苏格拉底，有一篇对话录叫《高尔吉亚篇》，其中苏格拉底的一位朋友卡利克勒斯试图劝他放弃进行哲学思考。

endorsed.def_en: agreed with or approved of a principle or idea

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Here's the obvious question, what became of the principle better to save five lives even if it means sacrificing one, what became of the principal that almost everyone endorsed in the first case?
contexts.trans: 这里有个显而易见的问题：那个“宁可牺牲一个人也要救五个人”的原则怎么了？那个在第一个案例中几乎所有人都赞同的原则怎么了？

reconciling.def_en: making two different ideas or situations exist together without conflict

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Who else can find a way of reconciling the reaction of the majority in these two cases? Yes?
contexts.trans: 还有谁能找到一种办法，把这两种情况下大多数人的反应调和起来？有吗？

emergency.def_en: a sudden serious and dangerous situation requiring immediate action

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Let's forget for the moment about this case. That's good, but let's imagine a different case. This time you're a doctor in an emergency room.
contexts.trans: 我们先暂时忘掉这个案例。很好，但让我们想象一个不同的案例。这一次你是急诊室里的医生。

controversies.def_en: public disagreements or arguments about important issues

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: You'll notice too from the syllabus that we don't only read these books, we also all take up contemporary political and legal controversies that raise philosophical questions.
contexts.trans: 你们从教学大纲中还会注意到，我们不只是读这些书，我们还会讨论当代政治和法律中引发哲学问题的种种争议。

equality.def_en: the state of being equal in rights, status, or opportunities

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: We will debate equality and inequality, affirmative action, free speech versus hate speech, same sex marriage, military conscription.
contexts.trans: 我们将辩论平等与不平等、平权行动、言论自由与仇恨言论、同性婚姻、征兵制。

inequality.def_en: an unfair difference in social status, wealth, or opportunities among people

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: We will debate equality and inequality, affirmative action, free speech versus hate speech, same sex marriage, military conscription.
contexts.trans: 我们将辩论平等与不平等、平权行动、言论自由与仇恨言论、同性婚姻、征兵制。

unsettles.def_en: to make someone feel anxious or uneasy

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: These risks spring from that fact that philosophy teaches us and unsettles us by confronting us with what we already know.
contexts.trans: 这些风险源于一个事实：哲学通过让我们直面自己已知的东西，来教导我们，也让我们感到不安。

hypotheticals.def_en: imagined situations or examples used to test an idea

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: That's how those examples worked, worked the hypotheticals with which we began, with their mix of playfulness and sobriety.
contexts.trans: 我们开头那些例子、那些假设情境，也正是这样起作用的——它们既带着几分戏谑，又带着几分严肃。

estranges.def_en: to make someone feel separated or alienated from something familiar

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: It's also how these philosophical books work. Philosophy estranges us from the familiar, not by supplying new information, but by inviting and provoking a new way of seeing.
contexts.trans: 这些哲学书也是如此起作用的。哲学使我们与熟悉的事物相疏远，靠的不是提供新信息，而是邀请并激起一种新的看待方式。

provoking.def_en: causing a reaction or new idea to arise in someone

contexts.sentence: Self-knowledge is like lost innocence; however unsettling you find it, it can never be unthought or unknown.
contexts.trans: 自我认知就像失去的天真；无论它让你多么不安，它都再也无法不去想或不知道。

enterprise.def_en: a large project or undertaking, especially one that is difficult or ambitious

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: What makes this enterprise difficult but also riveting, is that Moral and political philosophy is a story, and you don't know where this story will lead, but what you do know is that the story is about you.
contexts.trans: 这项事业之所以既困难又引人入胜，是因为道德与政治哲学是一个故事，你不知道这个故事会把你引向何方，但你知道的是，这个故事讲的就是你自己。

presuppositions.def_en: things that are assumed to be true before an argument or discussion can proceed

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: You will examine the presuppositions of public policy, you will hone your political judgment, you'll become a more effective participant in public affairs.

judgment.def_en: the ability to make sensible decisions or form opinions about situations

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Callicles tells Socrates philosophy is a pretty toy if one indulges in it with moderation at the right time of life, but if one pursues it further than one should, it is absolute ruin.
contexts.trans: 卡利克勒斯告诉苏格拉底，哲学是个漂亮的玩具，如果一个人在人生恰当的年纪有节制地玩玩它的话；但如果一个人追求它超出了应有的限度，那就是彻底的毁灭。

conventions.def_en: traditional ways of behaving that most people in a society accept

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: And Callicles did have a point, he had a point. Because philosophy distances us from conventions, from established assumptions, and from settled beliefs.
contexts.trans: 卡利克勒斯确实有他的道理，他是有道理的。因为哲学让我们远离习俗，远离既定的假设，远离根深蒂固的信念。

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: And the reason they're unavoidable, the reason they're inescapable, is that we live some answer to these questions every day.
contexts.trans: 而它们之所以不可避免、之所以无法逃避，是因为我们每天都活在对这些问题某种回答之中。

temptations.def_en: things that make you want to do something unwise or wrong

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: I've tried to suggest through these stories and these arguments some sense of the risks and temptations, of the perils and the possibilities. I would simply conclude by saying.

dilemmas.def_en: a situation in which a difficult choice must be made between two options

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: Last time we started out last time with some stories, with some moral dilemmas about trolley cars and about doctors and healthy patients vulnerable to being victims of organ transplantation.

contexts.source_title: 第 01 集：杀人的道德侧面 / 海难食人案司法审判
contexts.sentence: And so we should base morality, whether we are thinking of what to do in our own lives or whether as legislators or citizens we are thinking about what the law should be, the right thing to do individually or collectively.
